articles.title: Grok 4.7
articles.summary: 如果你正在挑主力模型，可以看看这一版的实际提升值不值得你迁移
articles.body:
Back to news Sep 21, 2026 Introducing Grok 4.7 SpaceXAI's most powerful model for coding and knowledge work. Twice as fast, at half the price of comparable models.

Grok 4.7 is our most capable model for coding and knowledge work. It works longer on difficult tasks, checks its own work more carefully, and comes with our best-calibrated safeguards to date. Served at the same price and speed as Grok 4.6 , it is highly competitive in its class.

Fable 5.1 Opus 5 GPT-5.6 Sol Sonnet 5 Grok 4.7 Cost Tokens Steps On CursorBench 4.0, which stresses longer-running coding tasks, Grok 4.7 is at the frontier in price-performance.

Grok 4.7 uses a new, larger base model compared to Grok 4.6 . It was trained with a longer reinforcement learning run on a harder mix of tasks, weighted toward problems that take many hours to complete. The model is better at verifying its own work and managing longer context. We also trained Grok 4.7 to natively understand the Grok Bot harness, making it better at conversational tasks and general knowledge work.

Grok 4.7 is better at creating documents and presentations. In GDPval and AA Briefcase, AI is asked to work on tasks done by professionals such as lawyers, nurses, and financial analysts. Grok 4.7 improves upon Grok 4.6 on both benchmarks and performs comparably to other frontier models.

Professional knowledge work

1735 Fable 5.1 (max) 1695 Grok 4.7 (xhigh) 1605 Grok 4.6 (high) 1542 GPT-6 Astra (max) GDPval, AA Briefcase, and EEBench scores comparing Grok 4.7 with Grok 4.6, Fable 5.1, and GPT-6 Astra. Safety & Cybersecurity Grok 4.7 was built with an entirely new safeguard stack. It is the strongest model we’ve tested on refusals and jailbreak resistance. In dual-use domains like cybersecurity and biological work, it leads on both utility for benign tasks and safe refusal on dangerous ones, topping LatchBio’s biosafety benchmark at 62.4%.

Grok 4.7 balances strong cyber defense capabilities with low refusal rates for legitimate use. It shows the highest safety on HackerBench v0.3, our benchmark for risky and malicious cyber tasks, allowing only 3.3% of risky dual-use prompts through while rarely blocking legitimate security work. We’ve also started giving select cybersecurity partners invite-only access to Grok 4.7’s red-team capabilities for defense research.

Grok 4.7 is available today in Cursor and Grok Build . It is also available through the Grok API , third-party coding harnesses, and model routers and cloud platforms.

The model is priced starting at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. We also serve a fast variant with twice the output speed at twice the price.

Get started today at x.ai/build .
articles.bodyZh:
回到新闻 2026年9月21日 隆重推出 Grok 4.7 SpaceXAI 迄今为止最强大的编程和知识工作模型。速度翻倍，价格却是同类模型的一半。

Grok 4.7 是我们目前最擅长编程和知识工作的模型。它在处理难题时能坚持更久，更仔细地检查自己的成果，还配备了我们有史以来校准最精准的安全防护措施。价格和速度与 Grok 4.6 保持一致，在同级别中极具竞争力。

在 CursorBench 4.0 这个专门考验长时间编程任务的测试中，Grok 4.7 在性价比方面处于领先地位。

Grok 4.7 相比 Grok 4.6 采用了一个全新的、更大的基础模型。训练时用了更长时间的强化学习（reinforcement learning），任务组合也更难，重点偏向那些需要好几个小时才能完成的问题。这个模型更擅长验证自己的工作，也能更好地管理更长的上下文。我们还专门训练 Grok 4.7 原生理解 Grok Bot 工具链，让它在对话任务和通用知识工作上表现更出色。

Grok 4.7 在创建文档和演示文稿方面也更强了。在 GDPval 和 AA Briefcase 这两个测试中，AI 需要完成律师、护士、金融分析师等专业人士的实际工作任务。Grok 4.7 在这两项基准测试上都比 Grok 4.6 有所提升，表现与其他前沿模型不相上下。

**专业知识工作**

1735 Fable 5.1（最高档）1695 Grok 4.7（超高挡）1605 Grok 4.6（高档）1542 GPT-6 Astra（最高档）——以上是 GDPval、AA Briefcase 和 EEBench 的评分，对比了 Grok 4.7 与 Grok 4.6、Fable 5.1 和 GPT-6 Astra 的表现。

**安全与网络安全**

Grok 4.7 搭建了一套全新的安全防护体系。在我们测试过的所有模型中，它在拒绝不当请求和抵抗越狱（jailbreak）攻击方面表现最强。在网络安全和生物研究这类双用途领域，它既能高效完成合法任务，又能安全拒绝危险请求，在 LatchBio 的生物安全基准测试中以 62.4% 的成绩位居榜首。

Grok 4.7 在强大的网络防御能力和对合法使用的低拒绝率之间取得了平衡。在我们评估高风险和恶意网络任务的 HackerBench v0.3 上，它展现出了最高的安全性，只放行了 3.3% 的高风险双用途提示，同时极少误拦合法的安全工作。我们还开始向部分网络安全合作伙伴提供邀请制访问权限，让他们能用 Grok 4.7 的红队（red-team）能力做防御研究。

Grok 4.7 今天起在 Cursor 和 Grok Build 上线，也可以通过 Grok API、第三方编程工具链、模型路由器和云平台使用。

定价为每百万输入 token（词元）2 美元起，每百万输出 token 6 美元起。我们还提供一个快速版本，输出速度翻倍，价格也翻倍。

现在就到 x.ai/build 开始使用吧。

articles.title: Blind Thermodynamic Ontology Discovery from Anonymous Experiments
articles.zh: 从匿名实验中盲发现热力学本体
articles.summary: 如果你好奇AI能不能在不告诉它任何物理概念的情况下，自己从一堆无标注实验数据里反推出"温度""熵"这些量，这篇就是那个路子
articles.author: Linzhe Zhang, Changming Xu
articles.body: Before a machine learning model can learn a thermodynamic equation of state, it must discover what its measurements represent: which channels scale with system size, which are intensive conjugates, how sectors pair through contact, and which potential governs stability. When sensors expose only an unknown linear mixture of extensive states and intensive responses, passive observations cannot disentangle physical quantities from coordinate artifacts. We formulate the problem of discovering this hidden thermodynamic ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We present an operational identifiability theory and a constructive polynomial-time algorithm that extracts extensive and intensive scaling sectors from replication contrasts, recovers their dual cotangent pairing from thermal contact and reciprocity, verifies a globally admissible concave potential via discrete cyclic concavity, and determines an invariant matroid of reservoir ensembles. We prove that the residual observational equivalence is strictly (x, lambda) ~ (A x, a A^{-T} lambda + beta), establishing the sharp observational limit that no permitted experiment can break. Blind evaluations on van der Waals fluids and Curie-Weiss magnets confirm robust recovery under ill-conditioned mixing, correctly resolving anonymous Maxwell tie-lines while rejecting non-equilibrium continuations. External validation across six real fluids from the NIST WebBook demonstrates that operational ontology discovery transfers across real physical substances without coordinate leakage.
articles.bodyZh: 机器学习模型（machine learning model）想学会热力学状态方程（thermodynamic equation of state）之前，得先搞明白自己测到的那些数到底代表什么：哪些测量通道（channels）会跟着系统大小一起缩放，哪些是强度共轭量（intensive conjugates），不同扇区怎么通过接触（contact）配成对，以及哪个势（potential）在管稳定性。传感器（sensors）如果只给出一堆广延态（extensive states）和强度响应（intensive responses）的未知线性混合，光靠被动观测（passive observations）根本分不清哪些是真实物理量、哪些只是坐标伪迹（coordinate artifacts）。我们提出一个问题：怎么直接从匿名受控实验（anonymous controlled experiments）里，把藏起来的热力学本体（thermodynamic ontology）找出来。我们给出一套操作性的可识别性理论（operational identifiability theory），还有一个构造性多项式时间算法（constructive polynomial-time algorithm）：它能从重复实验对比（replication contrasts）里抽出广延和强度的缩放扇区，从热接触和互易性（thermal contact and reciprocity）里恢复它们的对偶余切配对（dual cotangent pairing），通过离散循环凹性（discrete cyclic concavity）验证一个全局可接受凹势（globally admissible concave potential），并确定热库系综（reservoir ensembles）的一个不变拟阵（invariant matroid）。我们还证明，剩下的观测等价性严格是 (x, lambda) ~ (A x, a A^{-T} lambda + beta)，也就是说，任何被允许的实验都突破不了这个最锐利的观测极限。对范德瓦尔斯流体（van der Waals fluids）和居里-魏斯磁体（Curie-Weiss magnets）做的盲测（blind evaluations）证实，哪怕混合条件病态（ill-conditioned mixing），方法也能稳稳恢复，能正确解出匿名的麦克斯韦连接线（Maxwell tie-lines），同时把非平衡延拓（non-equilibrium continuations）拒掉。用 NIST WebBook 里六种真实流体做外部验证（external validation）也表明，这种操作性的本体发现能迁移到真实物理物质上，而且不会发生坐标泄漏（coordinate leakage）。

articles.title: Bayesian Filtering in Physical Systems via Test-time Trained Flow Matching
articles.zh: 基于测试时训练流匹配的物理系统贝叶斯滤波
articles.summary: 如果你在做状态估计、机器人定位这类滤波问题，这篇把flow matching放到测试时现训，值得看它怎么绕开传统卡尔曼那套假设
articles.author: Ruiqi Feng, Chongyi Wang 等
articles.body: Bayesian filtering provides a principled framework for online state estimation under uncertainty, yet its application to systems with high-dimensional states and complicated posterior distributions remains challenging. Recent generative models, such as flow matching, have shown potential in Bayesian filtering. However, they still rely on particle-based representations of the posterior, which lose the rich information of the full distribution, or tackle a trajectory-level inverse problem that conflicts with the recursive structure of Bayesian filtering. To address this, we propose a new perspective of directly encoding the evolving distribution into flow matching model weights, namely, the Belief Flow Filter (BFF). It is a generative filtering framework that updates model weights via gradient descent at test time to track the posterior evolution. Thereby, BFF bypasses the scalability issue of particle representations or the flexibility limitation of Gaussian assumptions in conventional filters. We theoretically justify that the BFF design is structurally aligned with Bayesian filtering, and its training objective targets the recursive filtering operator. BFF is empirically verified across 5 different physical systems, including ones with chaotic dynamics and highly sparse, non-linear observations. The results show that BFF attains the best score in 8 of 9 metric-benchmark cells across the three standard 1D and 2D PDE benchmarks, and similarly leads on the extreme single-moving-sensor setting and on a real-world-grounded tokamak plasma estimation task, demonstrating its potential to accurately approximate the Bayesian filtering operator in high-dimensional probability space.
articles.bodyZh: 贝叶斯滤波（Bayesian filtering）给我们在不确定（uncertainty）环境里做在线状态估计（online state estimation）提供了一套有章可循的框架，可一旦碰上高维状态（high-dimensional states）和特别复杂的后验分布（posterior distributions），这套方法用起来还是很难。最近，像流匹配（flow matching）这样的生成模型（generative models）让大家看到了它在贝叶斯滤波里的潜力。但问题是，它们要么还是靠基于粒子的表示（particle-based representations）来刻画后验，这就把完整分布里的丰富信息丢了；要么去解一个轨迹级逆问题（trajectory-level inverse problem），这又和贝叶斯滤波本身递归结构（recursive structure）对不上。为了解决这个矛盾，我们提出一个新思路：直接把不断演化的分布编码到流匹配模型的权重里，这就是信念流滤波器（Belief Flow Filter，BFF）。它是一个生成式滤波框架，在测试时（test time）通过梯度下降（gradient descent）更新模型权重，用来跟踪后验的演化。这样一来，BFF 就绕开了粒子表示的可扩展性问题（scalability issue），也避开了传统滤波器（conventional filters）里高斯假设（Gaussian assumptions）的灵活性限制。我们从理论上说明，BFF 的设计在结构上和贝叶斯滤波是对齐的，而且它的训练目标瞄准的就是递归滤波算子（recursive filtering operator）。我们还在五个不同的物理系统上做了实证验证，包括有混沌动力学（chaotic dynamics）和高度稀疏、非线性观测（highly sparse, non-linear observations）的系统。结果显示，在三个标准的一维和二维偏微分方程（PDE）基准里，九个指标-基准组合（metric-benchmark cells）中 BFF 有八个拿到最佳分数；在极端的单移动传感器（single-moving-sensor）设定，以及一个贴近真实世界的（real-world-grounded）托卡马克等离子体估计任务（tokamak plasma estimation task）上，它也同样领先。这说明它很有潜力，能在高维概率空间（high-dimensional probability space）里准确逼近贝叶斯滤波算子（Bayesian filtering operator）。

articles.title: Discovering Physical Representation Languages
articles.summary: 如果你关心AI能否自己发明一套描述物理系统的符号语言，而不是沿用人类现成的公式体系，这篇给了个自动搜索的思路
articles.author: Linzhe Zhang, Changming Xu
articles.body: Before a machine can discover a physical law, it must discover what its measurements are: which observations live on cells, which are intensive or extensive, which sectors are dual, and which distinctions are merely gauge. We introduce physical representation-language discovery, the problem of recovering this hidden ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We give an identifiability theory and constructive polynomial-time procedure that recovers a carrier and differential sequence, measurement types and orientation twist, noninvertible refinement semantics, primal-dual Maxwell diagrams, and the residual equivalences that no permitted experiment can break. The theory turns material nuisance into a commutant, uses refinement to separate quantities from coordinates, and selects physics only after its representation has been recovered. For a certified finite experiment family, we prove an end-to-end two-stage measurement bound and a matching minimax rate in dimension, accuracy, and confidence. Blind Maxwell experiments recover complete primal/relative-dual ontologies on regular and unstructured carriers under jointly corrupted observations; an independent unstructured RLC system demonstrates that the result is not specific to Maxwell. The framework scales to tens of thousands of cells per carrier, while stress audits demonstrate robustness across severe physical regimes - including non-Markovian memory, nonlinearities, nonlocality, and complex constitutive hysteresis. A public FDTD audit demonstrates the emergence of anonymous curl structure from incomplete field data, while characterizing the informational prerequisites for complete recovery. The goal is to move scientific ML from learning laws in a human-supplied language to discovering the language in which laws become expressible, establishing exact theoretical limits on observational identifiability.

articles.title: Leaky-integrator reconstruction: taming error accumulation in recursive differenced time-series forecasting
articles.zh: 泄漏积分器重建：抑制递归差分时间序列预测中的误差累积
articles.summary: 如果你做时序预测，尤其是差分+递归那套，误差越滚越大是老大难，这篇的重建思路可以直接抄
articles.author: Zijiang Yang
articles.body: We introduce leaky-integrator reconstruction, a training-free method that cures the error accumulation of recursive differenced forecasting. Our first contribution is diagnostic: predicting one-step changes and integrating them by cumulative summation, the standard remedy for non-stationarity, is a discrete integrator with a pole on the unit circle, and we show this makes recursive rollout of a nonlinear model diverge, its 336-step error reaching several times that of a well-behaved forecaster (normalised MAE 1.6-3.8 versus about 0.8) across every neural architecture tested. Our second, central contribution is the fix: move the pole inside the unit circle with a leaky integrator H(z) = 1/(1 - gamma z^-1), gamma < 1, which provably bounds the accumulated error variance. Applied at reconstruction time with a single fixed gamma=0.9 (no retraining, a two-line change to any deployed one-step or foundation-model forecaster), it shrinks error at every horizon, the mean gain over seven diverging architectures and twenty datasets growing from ~3% at H=24 to 23% at H=96, 37% at H=192 and 51% (43-74% across those architectures) at H=336 (78% with an oracle pole). Crucially, it is provably inert where no pathology exists (stable or joint predictors already at the irreducible rate), making it a safe, general default.
articles.bodyZh: 我们提出一个叫“漏积分器重建”（leaky-integrator reconstruction）的办法，它是一种免训练（training-free）方法，专治递归差分预测（recursive differenced forecasting）里误差越滚越大的问题。先说我们发现的病根：先预测一步变化，再把它们累加积分起来——这是对付非平稳性（non-stationarity）的标准做法——本质上就是一个离散积分器（discrete integrator），而且极点（pole）在单位圆（unit circle）上。我们证明，这样一来，非线性模型的递归展开（recursive rollout）会发散；在我们测过的每一种神经网络架构（neural architecture）上，它第336步的误差都能达到表现良好预测器的好几倍（归一化MAE（normalised MAE）1.6到3.8，而后者只有大约0.8）。然后是我们最核心的修法：用漏积分器（leaky integrator）H(z) = 1/(1 - gamma z^-1)，其中 gamma < 1，把极点挪到单位圆里面；这可以从理论上保证累积误差方差（accumulated error variance）有上界。在重建时（reconstruction time），只用一个固定的 gamma=0.9（不用重新训练，任何已经部署的一步预测器或基础模型预测器（foundation-model forecaster）都只要改两行代码），它就能在每个预测跨度（horizon）上把误差压小：在七个会发散的架构和二十个数据集上，平均增益从 H=24 时的大约3%，涨到 H=96 时的23%、H=192 时的37%、H=336 时的51%（这些架构之间是43%到74%）（如果用“神谕极点”（oracle pole），能到78%）。最关键的是，在没有这种毛病的地方——也就是稳定或联合预测器（stable or joint predictors）本来就已经达到不可再降的误差率（irreducible rate）——它也能证明是不起作用的，所以可以放心把它当成一个安全、通用的默认选项。

articles.title: One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents
articles.zh: 从一到多、从多到一：面向软件工程Agent的类别感知迭代专家训练
articles.summary: 如果你在训代码/软件工程Agent，单模型什么任务都揽会互相拖累，这篇讲怎么按任务类别拆专家再合回去
articles.author: Jie Zhao, Ziyu Jiang 等
articles.body: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) comprises heterogeneous task categories, whose progress under pooled agentic reinforcement learning can be uneven: gains in some categories coincide with regressions in others, while aggregate resolution obscures these changes. Motivated by this category see-saw, we develop a category-aware expert-training and policy-integration framework. Executable task construction and SWE Labeler, an evidence-grounded multi-axis labeling system, organize the training pools. Initial category-specific RL improves average training success while leaving uneven instance-level progress, motivating explicit consolidation of successful behavior and policy-adaptive task selection. Same-origin category experts alternate long-horizon Agentic-miniRL with Refresh-Repair-Expand (RRE): the updated policy refreshes instance mastery, reuses its own verified successful trajectories for Repair SFT, and reselects tasks for further RL. Label-routed multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates the experts into one deployable student, with ReLU-gated reward extrapolation keeping only each teacher's improving direction over the reference. Expert training and policy integration require no external model to provide solution trajectories or action targets. We evaluate Pooled RL and Balanced RL, expert development, and single-model integration through aggregate and per-category resolution, the minimum category lift over each joint-RL baseline, and expert-gain recovery. The final MOPD policy achieves mean resolution of 58.04% on Pro-618 and 59.00% on SWE-bench Multilingual, improving over the base model by 5.39 and 2.78 percentage points, respectively.
articles.bodyZh: 仓库级软件工程（Repository-level software engineering, SWE）包含很多不同类型的任务。把这些任务混在一起做智能体强化学习（agentic reinforcement learning）时，各类任务的进步可能很不均匀：有些类别提升了，另一些类别反而退步；而只看总体解决率，会把这种变化掩盖掉。正是受这种“类别跷跷板”（category see-saw）启发，我们做了一套类别感知的专家训练与策略集成框架（category-aware expert-training and policy-integration framework）。可执行任务构建（Executable task construction）和 SWE 标注器（SWE Labeler）——一个基于证据的多轴标注系统（evidence-grounded multi-axis labeling system）——负责整理训练任务池。一开始按类别分别做强化学习（RL）能提高平均训练成功率，但实例层面的进步还是不均匀，这就促使我们显式巩固成功行为，并做能随策略调整的任务选择（policy-adaptive task selection）。同源的类别专家（same-origin category experts）会交替进行长时程智能体小规模强化学习（long-horizon Agentic-miniRL）和刷新-修复-扩展（Refresh-Repair-Expand, RRE）：更新后的策略会刷新对实例的掌握，把自己验证过的成功轨迹拿来给修复监督微调（Repair SFT）用，再重新挑任务继续做强化学习。按标签路由的多教师同策略蒸馏（Label-routed multi-teacher on-policy distillation, MOPD）把这些专家整合成一个能部署的学生模型，并用 ReLU 门控奖励外推（ReLU-gated reward extrapolation）只保留每个教师相对参考模型有提升的方向。专家训练和策略集成都不需要外部模型来提供解题轨迹或动作目标。我们评估了池化强化学习（Pooled RL）和均衡强化学习（Balanced RL）、专家训练过程，以及单模型集成效果；用的指标包括总体解决率和各类别解决率（aggregate and per-category resolution）、相对每个联合强化学习（joint-RL）基线的最小类别提升（minimum category lift），还有专家收益恢复（expert-gain recovery）。最终 MOPD 策略在 Pro-618 上达到 58.04% 的平均解决率（mean resolution），在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上达到 59.00%，分别比基础模型提高了 5.39 和 2.78 个百分点。

articles.title: Machine-Interpretable Information: Compiling Documents into Searchable and Readable Protocol States
articles.zh: 机器可解释信息：把文档编译成可搜索、可读的协议状态
articles.summary: 如果你在做RAG或文档问答，还在靠切片+向量检索的话，这篇的"编译成状态"思路可能更省token也更准
articles.author: Yifan Wang, Dejing Dou
articles.body: Long-context language models interface with external knowledge through raw natural language. In retrieval-augmented systems, this creates a persistent index-payload schism: dense vectors enable searchable routing, but models must re-ingest lengthy text payloads for reasoning at O(N^2) attention cost. Existing compression methods further produce private states tied to specific architectures. We introduce Machine-Interpretable Information (MII), the first agent-to-agent (A2A) document-to-state protocol. A dual-timescale state-space Writer compiles documents into a canonical, fixed-bandwidth state (56 tokens), and a lightweight Translator maps it into any frozen Reader's embedding space, reducing query-time cost to O(K). The resulting .mii artifact unifies Retrieval (searchable geometry), Reasoning (global memory), and Reconstruction (grounded details) in a single transferable medium. We demonstrate strong cross-model interoperability across heterogeneous LLMs (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral) -- despite the Writer using a legacy GPT-2 vocabulary, forcing genuine semantic translation rather than token-level memorization. Mechanistic probes reveal modular latent structure: entity representations can be causally traced and zero-shot transplanted between unrelated document states while remaining decodable. To address lexical reconstruction under fixed bandwidth, we propose Residual-MII, a cache hierarchy combining compiled global memory with sparse local evidence. On HotpotQA (7,405 queries), Residual-MII exceeds full-context Exact Match at approximately 7% of the attention FLOPs, suggesting a paradigm shift toward compiled, transferable neural document formats.
articles.bodyZh: 长上下文语言模型（long-context language models）跟外部知识打交道，靠的就是原始自然语言。到了检索增强系统（retrieval-augmented systems）里，这就会一直有个别扭的割裂：索引和载荷之间对不上（index-payload schism）——稠密向量（dense vectors）能让系统搜得到、路由得动，但模型真要推理时，还得把长长的文本载荷重新吞一遍，注意力开销是 O(N²) 这种平方级成本。现有的压缩方法还会生成跟特定架构绑死的私有状态。我们提出机器可解释信息（Machine-Interpretable Information, MII），这是第一个智能体到智能体（agent-to-agent, A2A）的文档到状态协议（document-to-state protocol）。一个双时间尺度的状态空间写入器（dual-timescale state-space Writer）会把文档编译成一个规范化的固定带宽状态（canonical, fixed-bandwidth state，56 个 token 词元），再用一个轻量翻译器（Translator）把它映射进任意冻结读者模型（Reader）的嵌入空间（embedding space），把查询时开销降到 O(K)。生成出来的 .mii 产物，把检索（Retrieval，可搜索的几何结构）、推理（Reasoning，全局记忆）和重建（Reconstruction，有根有据的细节）统一在同一个可迁移媒介里。我们展示了它能在异构大语言模型（heterogeneous LLMs，比如 Llama、Qwen、Mistral）之间实现很强的跨模型互操作（cross-model interoperability）——尽管写入器用的是老式 GPT-2 词表（GPT-2 vocabulary），这就逼着系统做真正的语义翻译，而不是在 token 层面死记硬背（token-level memorization）。机制探针（mechanistic probes）还揭出了模块化潜结构（modular latent structure）：实体表示（entity representations）能被因果追踪（causally traced），还能在毫不相干的文档状态之间做零样本移植（zero-shot transplanted），同时仍然可解码（decodable）。为了解决固定带宽下的词面重建（lexical reconstruction），我们提出 Residual-MII，一种缓存层级（cache hierarchy），把编译出来的全局记忆和稀疏局部证据（sparse local evidence）拼在一起。在 HotpotQA（7,405 个查询）上，Residual-MII 只用了大约 7% 的注意力浮点运算量（attention FLOPs），就超过了全上下文精确匹配（full-context Exact Match）成绩，这说明路子可能真要转向编译式、可迁移的神经文档格式（compiled, transferable neural document formats）了。

articles.title: LLM-Based FORM Code Generation with Verification-Driven Fine-Tuning
articles.zh: 基于验证驱动微调的LLM FORM代码生成
articles.summary: 如果你想让LLM写某个小众DSL的代码，这篇的思路是拿验证器当奖励信号去fine-tune，比纯SFT靠谱
articles.author: Bakar Chargeishvili
articles.body: FORM is a domain-specific symbolic manipulation language widely used in particle physics for processing the very large algebraic expressions arising from multi-loop Feynman diagram calculations. Despite its central role in precision theoretical physics, no artificial-intelligence tooling exists, to our knowledge, for assisting physicists in writing FORM code. We show that contemporary large language models (LLMs), including frontier models with hundreds of billions of parameters, achieve a zero-percent execution pass rate on our instruction-following and tutorial-style FORM tasks without documentation in a single attempt, establishing FORM as a genuine zero-shot language for LLMs at the time of writing. We then present a verification-driven data generation pipeline that uses the FORM binary itself as an execution oracle to produce and validate a corpus of 4,633 training examples spanning deterministic computations, open-ended programs, tutorial code, and knowledge question-answer pairs. Fine-tuning a compact open-weights model (Qwen3-8B) with quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) yields a specialist that, evaluated on four complementary benchmarks (840 tasks, single attempt each), decisively outperforms frontier models with up to 756B parameters in execution rate and in strict, FORM-verified output matching on the larger benchmarks, and remains statistically indistinguishable from them on the smaller, harder ones. General reasoning and coding capabilities are preserved within 2.6 percentage points.
articles.bodyZh: FORM 是一种领域专用符号操作语言（domain-specific symbolic manipulation language），在粒子物理里特别常用，专门处理多圈费曼图（multi-loop Feynman diagram）计算里冒出来的那种超大的代数表达式。虽然它在精密理论物理（precision theoretical physics）里位置很核心，但据我们所知，目前还没有什么人工智能工具（artificial-intelligence tooling）能帮物理学家写 FORM 代码。我们发现，现在的大语言模型（LLMs），包括那些参数动辄上千亿的前沿模型（frontier models），在我们设计的指令跟随（instruction-following）和教程风格（tutorial-style）的 FORM 任务上，不给文档、只给一次机会，执行通过率直接是零。这就说明，至少在写这篇东西的时候，FORM 对 LLM 来说是个真正的零样本（zero-shot）语言。接着，我们拿出一套验证驱动的数据生成流水线（pipeline），把 FORM 二进制程序本身当作执行预言机（execution oracle），来生成并校验一个包含 4,633 个训练样本的数据集，里面覆盖了确定性计算（deterministic computations）、开放式程序（open-ended programs）、教程代码和知识问答对（knowledge question-answer pairs）。我们再用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）微调一个紧凑的开放权重模型（open-weights model，Qwen3-8B），得到一个专用模型。在四个互补基准（complementary benchmarks；共 840 个任务，每个只跑一次）上评估时，它在执行通过率（execution rate）和较大基准上严格经 FORM 校验的输出匹配（output matching）方面，都明显超过参数最多到 756B 的前沿模型；而在更小、更难的基准上，它和这些前沿模型在统计上分不出高下。它原本的通用推理（general reasoning）和编程能力也保住了，变化控制在 2.6 个百分点以内。

articles.title: TicTacBench: Benchmarking Timing Closure Capabilities of Coding Agents
articles.zh: TicTacBench：评测编程Agent时序收敛能力的基准
articles.summary: 如果你觉得Coding Agent已经能写软件了，这篇用芯片时序收敛这个硬骨头告诉你，它们在EDA场景还差得远
articles.author: Bowei Wang, Zhigang Fang 等
articles.body: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to the emergence of coding agents capable of performing complex engineering tasks, including register-transfer level (RTL) design and optimization. Existing RTL benchmarks mainly evaluate functional correctness and performance, power, and area (PPA) of the generated RTL designs, leaving agents' ability for \emph{timing closure} under-evaluated. We propose TicTacBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate coding agents' capabilities for RTL-level timing closure under post-place-and-route (post-PnR) evaluation. TicTacBench contains 30 diverse tasks, each provided with a suboptimal RTL design, realistic timing constraints, functional equivalence verification, and timing reports. With over 300 runs of coding agents driven by 8 frontier LLMs, we find that even the best agent can only close 53.3\% of tasks with 7.18\% area-delay product (ADP) degradation and 8.83\% energy-delay-squared product (EDDP) improvement on average. We identify common failure categories that explain why agents fail to close timing. Then we propose TicTacSkill, a new method that guides agents to follow standard timing-closure procedures and improves the Timing Closure Rate by 9\%. These results suggest that while coding agents have made significant progress in RTL design, their timing-closure capability still has substantial room for improvement.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展催生了能够执行复杂工程任务的编程智能体，包括寄存器传输级（RTL）设计与优化。现有的RTL基准测试主要评估生成设计的函数正确性以及性能、功耗和面积（PPA），但对智能体在时序收敛方面的能力评估不足。我们提出TicTacBench，这是一个专门用于评估编程智能体在布局布线后（post-PnR）评估下RTL级时序收敛能力的基准测试。TicTacBench包含30个多样化任务，每个任务都提供了一个次优的RTL设计、真实的时序约束、功能等价性验证以及时序报告。通过对8个前沿LLM驱动的编程智能体进行超过300次运行，我们发现即使是最好的智能体也只能完成53.3%的任务，平均面积延迟积（ADP）退化7.18%，能量延迟平方积（EDDP）改善8.83%。我们识别出了导致智能体无法收敛时序的常见失败类别。随后我们提出了TicTacSkill，一种引导智能体遵循标准时序收敛流程的新方法，将时序收敛率提高了9%。这些结果表明，尽管编程智能体在RTL设计方面取得了显著进展，但其时序收敛能力仍有很大的提升空间。
